notes: TBox expansion paired with history-replace-0019 (Liberty ship: built in the United States -> Britain). Keeps the relation built_in and the new object Britain; the subject is a made-up class (a wartime freighter class) under the real class of Second World War cargo ships, deliberately not the Liberty ships, whose real builders were American. Derived queries work out facts about Britain (its capital, its language, its king at the outbreak of the war); each needs the edit plus one real bridge fact held by the models. The near query asks where the real Liberty ships were built: a method that over-applies the rule would answer Britain.
